item.text:
`npm start` failed because the local `.env` used `postgress://` instead of `postgres://` for `DATABASE_URL`. I corrected it and removed credential exposure from the startup error and [doctor script](/private/tmp/envtest.EYGoTT/shop-api/scripts/doctor.sh).

Verified: `npm start` succeeds, and `npm run doctor` reports `all good`. The current [server script](/private/tmp/envtest.EYGoTT/shop-api/src/server.js) prints “listening on :3000” but does not create an HTTP listener.
